The [AI Compute Finder](https://uw-compute-finder.vercel.app/) is a tool that filters the compute platforms open to UW-Madison researchers down to the ones that fit a piece of ML/AI work. Set the filters for how you want to work, what you are doing, who you are, what data you have and how you want to pay, then click a platform for its GPUs, limits, cost, data policies and an estimate of the largest models it can train, fine-tune or serve.

It covers campus services (CHTC, BadgerCompute, BadgerInfer, SSCC and SSCC Silo, and SMPH's Platform R and Platform X), national allocations (NAIRR Pilot, NSF ACCESS, National Research Platform) and the commercial clouds under UW-Madison contracts (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). GPU figures are crawled weekly from the providers' pages; model sizes are estimates, and data approval for FERPA or HIPAA work is per project, so confirm with the provider. Maintained by [DoIT Research Cyberinfrastructure](https://it.wisc.edu/about/division-of-information-technology/research-cyberinfrastructure/); corrections through the **Suggest a correction** link on the site.

## Related resources

- [**Compute**: Center for High Throughput Computing (CHTC)](https://uw-madison-datascience.github.io/ML-X-Nexus/Toolbox/Compute/CHTC.html): The free campus GPU pool.
- [**Compute**: BadgerCompute](https://uw-madison-datascience.github.io/ML-X-Nexus/Toolbox/Compute/BadgerCompute.html): Interactive notebooks with a GPU for short sessions.
- [**Compute**: UW-Madison Cloud Services (AWS, GCP, Azure)](https://uw-madison-datascience.github.io/ML-X-Nexus/Toolbox/Compute/UW-Cloud-Services.html): Institutional cloud accounts and a CHTC-versus-cloud comparison.
- [**Compute**: National Research Platform (NRP)](https://uw-madison-datascience.github.io/ML-X-Nexus/Toolbox/Compute/NRP-Nautilus.html): Free GPUs and hosted open-weight models.
- [**GenAI**: UW Generative AI Services & Policies](https://uw-madison-datascience.github.io/ML-X-Nexus/Toolbox/GenAI/GenAI-at-UW-Madison.html): Which hosted AI services are approved for which data.
